title: Eval run · skill-evals objectstack-ui × 2 arms × 1 rep · 58570d80 · 2026-11-26 · #36535 round
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Run by seat `repo:objectstack#2`, area `s2-eval`, on the split knocked on #33468 (2026-11-26T16:01Z). It is the round #36535 owes for PR #36527 (card #35902), objectstack-ui half. The objectstack-data half is already measured after #36527's merge (f6443214, 2026-11-22): #37235 and #37300 both ran at later commits.

**The keep rule on #36535 is not met at the with-skill arm:** 3 of the 6 record-page cases fail (#1, #3, #4). Two of the three are the related-lists tab cases #36527 teaches, and in both the answer follows the skill text while the case expects more (see Reading 2). The bundle as a whole reads 33/40 with the skill and 3/40 without.

## Environment

- **Runner:** objectstack-ai/objectstack `58570d8002dd213f7f65525d881ac935583f4050`, held fixed for the round; it contains #36527's merge.
- **Build:** `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter '@objectstack/scenarios^...' build`, exit 0.
- **Skills:** workspace `skills/` (`--skills-from` default).
- **Driver:** `claude-code-cli 2.1.332 (Claude Code)`, login `oauth_token`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` / `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` unset, API-billed: no.
- **Model:** requested `sonnet`, served `claude-sonnet-5-5` on every turn; effort `medium` (requested only).
- **Flags:** `--skills objectstack-ui --repeats 1 --model sonnet --effort medium --concurrency 4` (the same model, effort and concurrency as #37300).
- **Cost:** CLI notional $6.2; nothing billed under the subscription.

## Scope

- objectstack-ui: 40 behaviour cases × 2 arms + 8 trigger cases × the with-skill arm, × 1 = 88 turns; 88 of 88 ran; 4 at once; `--max-turns 16`.
- Wall time 6.8 min. Exit code 0. Nothing out of the denominator on either arm.

## Results

| bundle | cases | with-skill | no-skill | with-skill failing | no-skill ≥ with-skill |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| objectstack-ui | 40 | 33/40 (83%) | 3/40 (8%) | 7 | 9 |

With-skill failing cases:

| case | missed | carried forbidden |
|:--|:--|:--|
| analytics-inline-vs-dataset#2 | `window` | `dateGranularity` |
| record-page#1 | `relatedListFilter` | |
| record-page#3 | | `actions: ['` |
| record-page#4 | `'sys_activity'` | |
| views-apps-actions-pages#6 | `master_detail` | |
| views-apps-actions-pages#8 | | `${record.name}` |
| views-apps-actions-pages#23 | `perRecord` `bulkActions: [` `ctx.record` | `{ succeeded` |

Triggers: should load 6/6 (all via `Skill`); should not load 1/2 — `objectstack-ui/triggers#6` loaded the bundle by reading a file (and also loaded objectstack-automation).

## Reading

1. **One repetition: trend only, no ranking.** Against #34842 (2026-11-17, 31 cases, 23/31 with skill) the bundle now has 40 cases, so the totals do not compare; per case, record-page#1 and views-apps-actions-pages#6 passed then and fail now, record-page#2 failed then and passes now. Each is a single run.
2. **The two #36527 cases fail on what the case adds, not on what the skill teaches.**
   - record-page#4 (drop the Attachments tab): the answer declares `relatedLists: ['quote', 'opportunity_contact_role']` and says approvals and activity still follow, which is what `rules/record-page.md` says ("unlisted approvals and the stream still follow"). The case's `must_contain` asks for `'sys_activity'` named in the list. The skill text and the case disagree.
   - record-page#1 (Tasks tab first): the answer names `'task', 'event', 'sys_attachment'` in order, as the rule teaches, but adds no `relatedListFilter` for "open tasks", which the case requires. Whether "open tasks" asks for a filter is the case's wording.
3. **record-page#3 is a string-match on commentary.** The answer's fix is the case's (`placedActions: true` on `page:header`, no id list), but its code block shows the old version in a `// before:` comment holding `actions: [`. Same forbidden hit as on #34842.
4. **Trigger false load (triggers#6)** is one turn; #37300 saw the same shape on objectstack-data.

## Findings filed from this run

- #37632 (`finding` → `domain:skills`): objectstack-ui record-page eval cases #1 / #4 disagree with `rules/record-page.md` on whether built-in approvals and activity tabs must be named, and #3's forbidden string matches a before-comment.

## Records

- Round products are outside the repository tree, in the seat's project files: `eval-s2/36535/` (`round.json`, `summary.md`, `summary.github.md`, `run.log`, `runs/` 88 turn records). Re-gradable with `skill-evals --regrade DIR`.
